authors: Hetling JR, Baig-Silva MS, Comer CM, Pardue MT, Samaan DY, Qtaishat NM, Pepperberg DR, Park TJ
title: Features of visual function in the naked mole-rat Heterocephalus glaber
why: Electroretinographic and behavioural measures of visual function in the naked mole-rat itself; could settle flicker, sensitivity and receptor-class rows for the only Heterocephalus species. Author list from a course reference page; journal, volume and DOI from the reference list of McMullen et al 2010.

authors: Peichl L, Nemec P, Burda H
title: Unusual cone and rod properties in subterranean African mole-rats (Rodentia, Bathyergidae)
why: Names the naked mole-rat among three species with S-opsin dominated cones; the full text would give its cone and rod densities and opsin proportions.

title: The visual system in subterranean African mole-rats (Rodentia, Bathyergidae)
why: Review of the bathyergid visual system that is likely to state eye size, acuity-related anatomy and cone types for the naked mole-rat; the full author list is not on any page I opened.

authors: Schiviz AN, Ruf T, Kuebber-Heiss A, Schubert C, Ahnelt PK
title: Retinal cone topography of artiodactyl mammals: influence of body height and habitat
why: Cited by the 2024 Cervidae visual ecology review for cone streaks and the dorsotemporal extension, with the northern pudu named as lacking it; could give species-level cone density and anatomical sharpness for deer and perhaps bovids. DOI now confirmed (also on sweep-10 without one).
